To compute ${a}_{4},$ we first need to compute ${a}_{3}.$ So, we substitute $n=1$ into the recursive formula, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n+2} & ={a}_{n+1}+{a}_{n} \\ {a}_{1+2} & ={a}_{1+1}+{a}_{1} \\ {a}_{3} & ={a}_{2}+{a}_{1} \\ {a}_{3} & =1+(-1) \\ {a}_{3} & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Next, to compute ${a}_{4},$ we substitute $n=2$ into the recursive formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{2+2} & ={a}_{2+1}+{a}_{2} \\ {a}_{4} & ={a}_{3}+{a}_{2} \\ {a}_{4} & =0+1 \\ {a}_{4} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${a}_{4}=1.$
